rows.label: Voice engine
rows.fix: Pick an engine below. Auto-detect picks ElevenLabs whenever a key is present — which makes every preview cost credits — so ProseCast asks you to choose on purpose.

rows.label: Who's speaking (local AI)
rows.detail: Who's speaking (local AI) · http://localhost · not responding
rows.fix: Install Ollama from ollama.com and start it, or point the URL at a machine that runs it.

rows.label: Read-along timing (whisper)
rows.fix: Optional. Without it the read-along highlights by sentence (estimated) instead of by word.

rows.label: GPU headroom
rows.fix: Optional. If ComfyUI shares the GPU with Chatterbox, set its URL and ProseCast will check free VRAM (and reclaim it) before every render.
